evidence_summary: 23andMe's own release states TTAM, 'founded and led by Anne Wojcicki', completed the acquisition of the Personal Genome Service and Research Services business lines of 23andMe Holding Co. under Section 363 of the US Bankruptcy Code.

Reuters reports SpaceX is buying Anysphere, the startup behind Cursor, for $60 billion in an all-stock deal expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, with termination fees disclosed in the regulatory filing.
Reuters reports Katerra filed for Chapter 11 in the Southern District of Texas with liabilities of $1B-$10B against assets of $500M-$1B, after telling employees it planned to shut down.
Reuters confirms Argo is being shuttered with some employees moving to Ford and VW, and recounts VW's 2019 investment valued at $2.6 billion.
Reuters reports Theranos is about to dissolve itself after a failed sale process reaching more than 80 buyers, quoting CEO David Taylor's shareholder email, and notes investors lost about $1 billion.

Reuters reports Britishvolt filed for administration on 17 January 2023 after failing to raise funds for its planned GBP 3.8 billion plant, with creditors rejecting competing bids of around GBP 30 million.
Reuters confirms Quibi said it intends to wind down operations and begin a process to sell its assets six months after launch, backed by $1.8 billion from Hollywood studios and other investors.

Reuters reports Microsoft agreed to pay Inflection about $650 million in cash to use its models and hire most of its staff, and that Inflection used the fee to pay Greylock, Dragoneer and other investors a return of about 1.5x their investment.

Reuters reports Solyndra filed for bankruptcy in Delaware, having received $535 million in federal loan guarantees and raised more than $700 million of preferred shares from venture investors, with first-lien lenders ranking ahead of the government.
Reuters reports Better Place filed a motion in an Israeli court to wind up the company after a failed final fundraising round, requesting the appointment of a voluntary liquidator.
Reuters reports the bankruptcy judge approved WeWork's Chapter 11 plan, eliminating $4 billion of debt and handing the company's equity to a group of lenders and Yardi Systems.

Reuters confirms Character.AI granted Google a non-exclusive licence to its LLM technology, that co-founders Shazeer and De Freitas rejoined Google, and that Character.AI received further funding as part of the deal without disclosing the amount.
Reuters independently confirms the all-stock/cash tender at $13 per share for $103 million, a 137% premium, expected to close in Q4 2023.

Reuters confirms Google said it agreed to acquire DeepMind Technologies Ltd, notes Re/code reported the price as $400 million without sourcing, and that a Google spokesman declined to comment on the price - establishing the conflict between the $400m and GBP 400m figures.
Reuters wire copy confirms Rippling raised $450 million in a Series G valuing the company at $16.8 billion, plus a planned repurchase of up to $200 million of employee equity.

Sifted reports that Prima Materia, the firm founded by Daniel Ek and Shakil Khan, invested EUR10m into Epiterna, is the company's sole investor to date and helped incorporate it; the deal was led by Prima Materia's head of science translation.
Corroborates the $2B+ late-stage round at a $48B valuation and lists the participating investors, including Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Avenir, Benchmark, Bessemer and Nvidia.
